items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I didn't even know DePriest Dupreez had one.

ctx.x: How about Dupreez Wheeler? Did you know him? He played trombone and bass trombone. I think he was one of the first bass trombone players I ever saw. He had a bass trombone and -- for me -- in Cab's band.
Oh, yeah? I never saw it. I didn't even know DePriest Dupreez had one.
